{{See also|List of Single-board computers}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: ''[[Rockchip]]'' RK3506B :Tri-core ([[ARM]] Cortex-A7) @1.2GHz + :([[ARM]] Cortex-M0) @200MHz *Memory: 512MB (SDRAM) DDR3L *Storage: 8GB eMMC *WiFi & BT: , Bluetooth 5.2/BLE *Network: 1x Fast Ethernet w/ PoE (opt.) *USB: 1x USB 2.0 (Type-A) port, :1x 4-pin USB 2.0 connector *GPIO: 2x 26-pin Headers *Power Source: 5V/2A via USB Type-C
